name: core-dependencies
description: Dependencies, the core's blockers: the blocked field and the Workflow gate over one rule, across schemas; a blocker's outcome, which finishes it only when satisfiedBy lists it; gates on states a transition leaves; the edges addBlocker refuses; the blockers a create gives, held to the same checks; the lists; a blocker's delete, which removes its edges as the caller; reads as the caller; and its config rules.
